name: Full Throttle
verdict: A fast launch, a few seconds of nothing but blue sky, and the feeling of flying.
paragraphs: Full Throttle gets going immediately. The launch sends the train into its huge loop, and for a few seconds almost everything in front of me is sky. That feeling of flying was the best part.

metrics.label: Overall
metrics.assessment: 9/10

metrics.label: Ride feel
metrics.assessment: Fast. No slow build-up before the speed.

metrics.label: Smoothness
metrics.assessment: Smooth. A strong launch without much rattling.

metrics.label: Design & novelty
metrics.assessment: Memorable. The view becomes part of the ride.

name: X2
verdict: The whole park slowly unfolds below, then the seat starts turning every which way.
paragraphs: The climb is already part of the pleasure: the park gradually opens out in front of me. Then the seats rotate as the train moves through the course, so the changing orientation becomes the ride itself. I really liked it.

metrics.label: Overall
metrics.assessment: 8.5/10

metrics.label: Ride feel
metrics.assessment: Tumbling. Being turned around is part of the fun here.

metrics.label: Smoothness
metrics.assessment: Uneven. Some sections can shake noticeably.

metrics.label: Design & novelty
metrics.assessment: Inventive. The rotating seats keep changing the perspective.

name: West Coast Racers
verdict: Smooth, fast, and two rounds of racing in one ride.
paragraphs: I like the two-team racing idea, especially getting to go around twice. The West Coast Customs pit stop gives the race a setting, too. A coaster with some background to it, for once. It is a good ride, though not one of the most memorable here.
alt: Watercolor illustration of West Coast Racers

metrics.label: Overall
metrics.assessment: 7.5/10

metrics.label: Ride feel
metrics.assessment: Lively. Enough speed to make the race fun.

metrics.label: Smoothness
metrics.assessment: Smooth. The motion feels fluid even at speed.

metrics.label: Design & novelty
metrics.assessment: Playful. The second lap makes the racing concept more satisfying.

name: Twisted Colossus
verdict: A wooden-looking hybrid with enough in it to leave me thoroughly satisfied.
paragraphs: Twisted Colossus really has that hybrid character: the big wooden framework, with steel track threaded through it. The combination feels comfortable and smooth. Two passes in one ride were enough to get my fill. My favorite in the park.

metrics.label: Overall
metrics.assessment: 9.5/10

metrics.label: Ride feel
metrics.assessment: Satisfying. A generous ride, with a second pass to enjoy.

metrics.label: Smoothness
metrics.assessment: Smooth. Both passes flow well.

metrics.label: Design & novelty
metrics.assessment: Characterful. The wooden structure and steel track work well together.

name: Apocalypse
verdict: With enough force, even a brick can fly. Apparently, so can this much wood.
paragraphs: The end-of-the-world theme works for this one. It has that old wooden-coaster feeling, then charges ahead as if it wants to find out just how much wood can take. “力大砖飞” was the phrase that came to mind: enough brute force to make a brick fly. I liked it.

metrics.label: Overall
metrics.assessment: 7.5/10

metrics.label: Ride feel
metrics.assessment: Forceful. It really commits to that charge forward.

metrics.label: Smoothness
metrics.assessment: Rattly. Noticeable vibration rather than a polished glide.

metrics.label: Design & novelty
metrics.assessment: Fitting. The raw wooden character suits the apocalypse theme.

name: Goliath
verdict: Very tall, with a first drop that feels properly good.
paragraphs: Goliath climbs high, then makes good use of the height. That first plunge is the part I remember most. It feels older, but still reasonably well looked after.

metrics.label: Overall
metrics.assessment: 7.5/10

metrics.label: Ride feel
metrics.assessment: Exhilarating. The first drop is the highlight.

metrics.label: Smoothness
metrics.assessment: Smooth. Little rattling despite its age.

metrics.label: Design & novelty
metrics.assessment: Direct. The height delivers what it promises.

name: Viper
verdict: An ordinary roller coaster. No strong praise, no strong complaint.
paragraphs: Viper was fine. Nothing particularly stood out, and there is not much more to say about it.

metrics.label: Overall
metrics.assessment: 5.5/10

metrics.label: Ride feel
metrics.assessment: Ordinary. No strong reaction either way.

metrics.label: Smoothness
metrics.assessment: Mixed. Some transitions can feel abrupt.

metrics.label: Design & novelty
metrics.assessment: Conventional. Nothing that particularly stayed with me.

name: The New Revolution
verdict: Fine, without leaving much of an impression.
paragraphs: Nothing really to praise or complain about. It felt like a normal roller coaster.
alt: Watercolor illustration of The New Revolution

metrics.label: Overall
metrics.assessment: 6/10

metrics.label: Ride feel
metrics.assessment: Ordinary. Neither especially good nor bad.

metrics.label: Smoothness
metrics.assessment: Smooth. A fairly fluid ride through the curves.

metrics.label: Design & novelty
metrics.assessment: Unremarkable. No particular feature stayed with me.

name: Tatsu
verdict: A flying position that felt much milder than it looked.
paragraphs: Being suspended like this reminded me of The Flying Dinosaur. The feeling was quite nice, but it barely felt intense, almost like a children’s ride. Overall, fairly ordinary.

metrics.label: Overall
metrics.assessment: 6/10

metrics.label: Ride feel
metrics.assessment: Mild. Not particularly thrilling on this ride.

metrics.label: Smoothness
metrics.assessment: Smooth. A generally fluid flying motion.

metrics.label: Design & novelty
metrics.assessment: Familiar. The suspended position recalls The Flying Dinosaur.

name: Scream
verdict: Round and round and round, and still dizzy after getting off.
paragraphs: Scream was not fun. The motion felt very rough, and it kept turning and turning and turning until I was dizzy. I was still dizzy after getting off.

metrics.label: Overall
metrics.assessment: 4/10

metrics.label: Ride feel
metrics.assessment: Dizzying. The repeated rotations became unpleasant.

metrics.label: Smoothness
metrics.assessment: Rough. Very little of it felt fluid.

metrics.label: Design & novelty
metrics.assessment: Repetitive. A lot of motion without much enjoyment.

name: The Riddler’s Revenge
verdict: Half-crouching while my head knocks against the restraints. What the hell is this?
paragraphs: The standing position left me feeling half-crouched and already uncomfortable. Then the side-to-side motion kept knocking my head against the pads. One of the worst of the day, down there with Scream.
alt: Watercolor illustration of The Riddler’s Revenge

metrics.label: Overall
metrics.assessment: 4/10

metrics.label: Ride feel
metrics.assessment: Uncomfortable. The posture and head movement dominate the ride.

metrics.label: Smoothness
metrics.assessment: Jarring. Repeated side-to-side jolts.

metrics.label: Design & novelty
metrics.assessment: Awkward. Standing up added more discomfort than enjoyment.

name: WONDER WOMAN Flight of Courage
verdict: An unusual seat, and my thighs had every reason to object.
paragraphs: The position felt wrong from the start: legs spread wide, with the restraint pressing separately against the top of each thigh. It felt as if all the load was concentrated there, and my thighs were still uncomfortable afterward. The ride itself was not especially smooth either. No, not this one.
alt: Watercolor illustration of WONDER WOMAN Flight of Courage

metrics.label: Overall
metrics.assessment: 4/10

metrics.label: Ride feel
metrics.assessment: Uncomfortable. The pressure on the upper thighs is what stayed with me.

metrics.label: Smoothness
metrics.assessment: Uneven. Not particularly smooth.

metrics.label: Design & novelty
metrics.assessment: Awkward. The seating position did not work for me.

name: Gold Rusher
verdict: An old mine train with a warm, welcoming feel. Intimate, and easy to like.
paragraphs: Gold Rusher has the old-fashioned character I like in Magnum XL-200, at a much gentler pace. The mine-cart train follows the hills through a series of turns, keeping the surroundings close before ending in a descending spiral. That small-scale feel is a big part of its charm. I liked this one a lot.

metrics.label: Overall
metrics.assessment: 7.5/10

metrics.label: Ride feel
metrics.assessment: Welcoming. The slower pace makes it easy to settle into the ride.

metrics.label: Smoothness
metrics.assessment: Uneven. Rider reports describe some jolts through the turns.

metrics.label: Design & novelty
metrics.assessment: Intimate. Following the hillside keeps the ride close to its surroundings.
